notes: Inline question reply: question notifications show the prompt and a RemoteInput 'Reply' action so you can answer free-text without opening the app. A non-exported receiver validates the action, re-checks app lock, loads the encrypted host profile, sends with an 8.5s timeout and updates the same notification (Answer sent / Already answered / Couldn't send). Replies are withheld while app lock is on; lock-screen public versions hide the prompt; per-question notification ids. Also includes a regression test for the 0.2.115 startup NPE fix.
